description: In a walled 3-wide channel of settled flowing water (sources at x = 0, levels 1 to 7 downstream): walk upstream against the current, jump in the sources, drift, sneak downstream, strafe, jump in the shallow end.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
